question: Select the product when zinc granules react with dilute sulphuric acid:
solution:
The correct answer is __**ZnSO4**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When zinc granules react with dilute sulphuric acid, the reaction produces** zinc sulfate (ZnSO₄) and hydrogen gas (H₂).**
 
• The balanced chemical equation for the reaction is **Zn (s)+H₂SO₄ (aq)→ZnSO₄ (aq)+H₂ (g).**
 
• **Products**: Zinc sulfate (ZnSO₄) – a soluble salt. Hydrogen gas (H₂) – released as bubbles.
 
• The atomic numbers of the elements:** Zinc (Zn) 30, Hydrogen (H) 1, Sulfur (S): 16.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here are the major types of chemical reactions:
 
• **Combination (Synthesis) Reaction: **Two or more reactants combine to form a single product.
 
• **Decomposition Reaction**: A single compound breaks down into two or more simpler products.
 
• **Displacement (Single Replacement) Reaction**: One element displaces another in a compound.
 
• **Double Displacement (Metathesis) Reaction**: The ions of two compounds exchange places to form two new compounds.
 
• **Combustion Reaction**: A substance (usually a hydrocarbon) reacts with oxygen, releasing energy in the form of heat and light, producing CO₂ and H₂O.
 
• **Redox (Oxidation-Reduction) Reaction:** A reaction where one substance is oxidized (loses electrons) and another is reduced (gains electrons).
 
• **Exothermic and Endothermic Reactions**
